_note: NL -> SQL -> pinned answer question bank (proposal archive/database/company_metrics_grain_and_bank 3.3, seeded 2026-11-11 with 15 entries, grown to 46 in v2). Entries carry the NL question, the shape that answers it (metric_value for certified-grain lookups, sql for everything else), and an operator-attested pin computed from the committed snapshot and cross-checked against the live store. The probe runs this bank ALONGSIDE the frozen set by default; --no-bank skips it; --fail-on drifted is the CI gate. metric entries are keyed by ruling A1: one row per (entity, metric_label, period, consolidated) - latest filing within scope (ruling A1/B1). Restatements re-pin explicitly, never silently. Deliberately NOT pinned, because a pin would freeze a known-wrong or known-incomplete state: ultimate_parent for the Reliance group (an inverted subsidiary_of edge, vigil:rpt:RELIANCE, puts 238 companies under the leaf Reliance Lithium Werks B.V); NIFTY 500 membership (499 of 500); group hyperedge sizes (Adani 2, Bajaj 2, Hinduja 3 - sparse). Pin them once the underlying coverage is fixed. v3 (2026-11-11, rpt_attribution arc): 7 entries re-pinned after the ruled C1+A4+A-prime replay.
